# Fission-AI OpenSpec Architecture Planner
Upstream Repository: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec

## Overview
OpenSpec specification engine for autonomous software architecture proposals, dev plans, business plans, and role assignments.
Integrated into AIFoundry.sh as `/v1/tools/openspec.plan` paired with Nemotron AI & Grok.

## Persona Roles Matrix
1. **Atlas (Lead Architect)**: Core system bounds, data contracts, and edge isolates
2. **Vanguard (Security Auditor)**: 0x key protection, HMAC token scopes, and x402 compliance
3. **Meridian (Business Strategist)**: Unit economics, ≥ 3x COGS margins, and x402 monetization models
4. **Nova (Technical Writer)**: cURL, JS, Python, and Rust client integration examples
